study.description: 1,056-fold rolling-origin walk-forward over DoltHub end-of-day chains (SPY and AAPL; QQQ configured but absent from the export) plus a single-year SPY 2023 run, constant rate and dividend yields.

qqq_option_chain_rows.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM option_chain WHERE act_symbol='QQQ'

acquisition_audits.note: Acquisition filters (quote validity, relative spread) run at ingest before storage; the per-run audits live under data/<root>/audits/<run_id>/filter_audit.csv and are not committed.

full-history-v2.role: Full-history walk-forward cited throughout docs/RESULTS.md (3.2.1 code: Newey-West variant, per-symbol fold losses)
full-history-v2.command: python -m options_engine walk-forward --config config/eod-full.json --output results/full-history-v2 --min-train-sessions 120 --gap 1 --window rolling --max-train-sessions 250
full-history-v2.command_note: Command as given in docs/RESULTS.md (full history) or implied by significance.json spec (SPY 2023); the shell history does not contain it.

spy-2023-v2.role: Single-year SPY 2023 walk-forward cited in docs/RESULTS.md
spy-2023-v2.command: python -m options_engine walk-forward --config config/eod.json --output results/spy-2023-v2 --min-train-sessions 60 --gap 1 --window expanding
spy-2023-v2.command_note: Command as given in docs/RESULTS.md (full history) or implied by significance.json spec (SPY 2023); the shell history does not contain it.

full-history-v1.role: Same specification run before the Newey-West variant existed; identical DM and bootstrap values; already committed

spy-2023-v1.role: SPY 2023 run before the Newey-West variant; identical DM and bootstrap values; local only, superseded by spy-2023-v2
